default_distro.description: The name of the default Linux distribution installed via wsl --install or wsl -d

default_version.description: The default WSL version (1 or 2) for new distributions, set via wsl --set-default-version

kernel_path.description: Path to the custom Linux kernel for WSL 2, from microsoft/WSL2-Linux-Kernel

experimental_features.description: List of experimental feature flags to enable in WSL

networking.mode.description: Network mode for WSL (nat, mirrored, internal, external)

networking.ipv4_address.description: Static IPv4 address for the WSL virtual machine network interface

networking.dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers for the WSL instance

filesystem.description: File system integration settings between Windows and WSL

filesystem.mount_windows_drives.description: Whether to automatically mount Windows partitions in WSL

filesystem.mount_point.description: The directory path where Windows drives are mounted in Linux

enable_telemetry.description: Whether to allow WSL to send diagnostic data/telemetry to Microsoft

update_channel.description: The update channel for WSL (stable, dev, beta, release_preview) as per Windows Insiders Program
